label: visual-only
vendored_note: Nothing was downloaded, vendored or executed. The plan is closed-form geometry; the ground stays the Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles Cesium already draws.

sources.name: Geometric horizon of a sphere, d = sqrt(2 R h + h^2), dip = acos(R / (R + h)); IUGG mean Earth radius 6371008.8 m
sources.used_for: horizon range, dip, the depression-to-range inversion in the pixel gate
sources.note: the atmosphere lane (atmosphere_clouds.aerial_perspective.alpine) uses a 6360 km planet radius; the two differ by 0.09 % in horizon range

sources.name: Terrestrial refraction coefficient k = 0.13 (Gauss; standard surveying value)
sources.used_for: recorded only: how much farther the real horizon is than the rendered, unrefracted one. Not used by the gate.
sources.note: typed from memory, not fetched in this session

sources.name: OGC 3D Tiles 1.0 specification, screen-space error: sse = geometricError * screenHeight / (distance * 2 tan(fovy / 2))
sources.licence: OGC document licence (formula only; no text or code copied)
sources.used_for: the geometric-error bound per distance and the 1/SSE^2 tile-count model
sources.note: typed from memory, not fetched in this session; the tile-count constants (tile span per geometric error, bytes per tile) are ASSUMED and UNCALIBRATED
